title: At a hotel in English: 8 phrases, a real conversation and speaking practice | English Routine
description:
At a hotel — في الفندق
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:40 The conversation
1:13 3 questions
1:38 Your turn: speak

Words
• reservation = حجز
• single room = أوضة سينجل (لفرد واحد)
• double room = أوضة لاتنين
• check out = يسلّم الأوضة ويمشي
• included = داخل / محسوب في السعر
• wake-up call = مكالمة صحيان
• it doesn't work = مش شغال
• available = متاح / فاضي

Practice this situation in the app (it plays the other person and shows you what to fix), one of 665 real-life situations, A1 to C2:
